description: This file defines an Angular service class 'AuthService' responsible for authentication management, including login, logout, session handling, and profile updates. It interacts with an API service and manages user state using BehaviorSubject.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: An Angular Injectable service handling user authentication, session, and profile management.

methods.name: session$
methods.description: Observable of the current user session profile.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Boolean getter indicating if a user session is active.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login operation, storing authentication token and updating user state.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by clearing stored token and user data.

methods.name: loadProfile
methods.description: Loads the user profile from the backend API and updates the user state.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates the user profile via API and updates user state.
